ext_name.description: Extension name; also the camera name pages show. Not translated.

ext_description.message: Offers web pages a Remote Visio Camera: the camera of the device sending to this Mac through Remote Visio.
ext_description.description: Extension description in the extensions page (at most 132 characters).

slate_connecting.description: Slate (the picture shown instead of the camera): connecting to the receiver.

slate_waiting.description: Slate: connected, but the sending device sends no camera.

slate_waiting_hint.message: Turn on “Send this device's camera” on the sending device
slate_waiting_hint.description: Slate, under slate_waiting. Quotes the sender page's checkbox label.

slate_down.message: Remote Visio is not running on this Mac
slate_down.description: Slate: the Remote Visio receiver does not answer.

slate_down_hint.message: Already running? If its menu has no “Browser Camera”, update Remote Visio.
slate_down_hint.description: Slate, under slate_down. An older Remote Visio has no browser camera and reads as not running; quotes the menu item bcam_toggle of the menu-bar app.

slate_refused.message: Remote Visio does not accept this copy of the extension
slate_refused.description: Slate: the receiver refused this extension's ID: a copy it does not know, such as one unpacked from the Chrome Web Store zip (no key, so an ID of its own).

slate_refused_hint.message: Remove it on the browser's extensions page, then choose “Install Browser Camera Extension…” in the Remote Visio menu.
slate_refused_hint.description: Under slate_refused. Quotes the menu item bcam_install of the menu-bar app.

slate_off.message: The browser camera is turned off in the Remote Visio menu
slate_off.description: Slate: the receiver runs with the browser camera switched off in its menu.

slate_busy.message: The camera is busy: too many pages are using it
slate_busy.description: Slate: the receiver serves too many pages already.

slate_codec.message: This browser cannot play the camera's H.264 video
slate_codec.description: Slate: the browser offered no H.264 decoder.

slate_blocked.message: This browser blocked the local connection to Remote Visio
slate_blocked.description: Slate: the receiver answered, but the browser never let the connection to it come up (a WebRTC policy or setting, or a refused local network access).

slate_blocked_hint.message: In this site's settings, allow it to access other apps and services on this device, or ask your IT department about the browser's WebRTC policy

popup_question.description: Popup: a consent window is open for this site, and may have gone behind the browser's window; popup_question_show brings it back.

popup_question_show.description: Popup: button next to popup_question that brings the consent window to the front.

popup_checking.description: Popup status before the first answer.

popup_status_down.message: Remote Visio is not running on this Mac
popup_status_down.description: Popup status: the receiver does not answer.

popup_status_down_hint.message: Already running? If its menu has no “Browser Camera”, update Remote Visio.
popup_status_down_hint.description: Popup, under popup_status_down. An older Remote Visio has no browser camera and reads as not running; quotes the menu item bcam_toggle of the menu-bar app.

popup_status_refused.message: Remote Visio does not accept this copy of the extension
popup_status_refused.description: Popup status: the receiver refused this extension's ID: a copy it does not know, such as one unpacked from the Chrome Web Store zip (no key, so an ID of its own).

popup_status_refused_hint.message: Remove it on the browser's extensions page, then choose “Install Browser Camera Extension…” in the Remote Visio menu.
popup_status_refused_hint.description: Under popup_status_refused. Quotes the menu item bcam_install of the menu-bar app.

popup_status_off.message: The browser camera is turned off in the Remote Visio menu
popup_status_off.description: Popup status: browser camera switched off in the menu-bar app.

popup_status_waiting_hint.message: Turn on “Send this device's camera” on the sending device.

popup_in_use_count.description: Popup: the sites watching now, when there are more connections than sites (several pages of a site, or connections that named no site). COUNT is always 2 or more.

popup_in_use_unnamed.description: Popup: connections watching that did not come from a site through this extension.

popup_enabled.message: Offer Remote Visio Camera to websites
popup_enabled.description: Popup switch: add the camera to web pages.

popup_enabled_hint.message: Sites list it with their cameras. You are asked before a site uses it for the first time.

popup_prefer.message: Use it when a site asks for any camera
popup_prefer.description: Popup switch: answer requests for any camera with this one.

popup_prefer_hint.message: Instead of this Mac's own camera.

popup_sites.description: Popup: heading of the list of sites.

popup_no_sites.message: No site has asked for the camera yet.
popup_no_sites.description: Popup: the list of sites is empty.

popup_site_allowed.description: Popup: a site the user allowed.

popup_site_blocked.description: Popup: a site the user refused.

popup_site_remove.description: Popup: button that forgets a site's answer.

consent_question.message: Allow $ORIGIN$ to use Remote Visio Camera?

consent_embedded.message: Asked by $FRAME$, embedded in this site.
consent_embedded.description: Consent window, under the question, when a frame of another site embedded in the page asked.

consent_body.message: The site will see the remote device's camera.

consent_note.message: You can change this later in the Extensions menu (the puzzle-piece icon) › Remote Visio Camera.
consent_note.description: Consent window, small print. Chrome's Extensions menu, whose toolbar icon is a puzzle piece.

consent_invalid.message: This request is no longer valid.
consent_invalid.description: Consent window opened without a valid site.
